newsitem.title: CANADA: TimberWest says sale likely to take months.
newsitem.headline: TimberWest says sale likely to take months.

text.p: TimberWest Forest Ltd said on Friday that its search for a buyer for the company will likely take three months or more.

The Canadian lumber company announced earlier that it and its 52 percent owner Fletcher Challenge Canada Ltd would seek to find a buyer for TimberWest. Fletcher Canada is majority-owned by New Zealand's Fletcher Challenge Ltd.
TimberWest chief financial officer Wanda Costuros said the sale process was just being launched, "but it's hard to imagine it would take less than three months."
A Fletcher spokesman said the company had no target date in mind for the sale.
"We'll have to see what kind of interest there is," he said.
The two companies are forming an independent committee to pursue the sale. He said there has been no contact with any potential buyers yet.
Fletcher feels TimberWest is undervalued. He declined to say how much Fletcher believes it is worth.
Fletcher's move was motivated by its view TimberWest is undervalued and a desire to exit the solid-wood business, Costuros said.
